integrity: The proof uses exact dual support inequalities and five explicit continuum witness families. The bundled symbolic checker verifies every dual-facet separation and proves each witness family over its entire parameter interval by affine endpoint checks. No finite sampling is used as proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the regular dodecagonal Banach plane and does not classify all regular polygons, all extremizing pairs, or stability of near-extremizers.
title: Exact angle modulus of convexity of the regular dodecagonal Banach plane
